callings.name: Gunner
callings.perk: +2 on every duel spin. Loud, proud, slightly deaf.

callings.name: Navigator
callings.perk: Never sails fewer than 3. Knows a shortcut.

callings.name: Ship’s Surgeon
callings.perk: Patches ’em up: the Kraken can’t take your crew.

callings.name: Cook
callings.perk: Sells the grog: +300 whenever anyone lands on Grog.

callings.name: Shantyman
callings.perk: Tavern Tales pay double, +300 per Legend vote.

callings.name: Smuggler
callings.perk: Knows a fella: misfortunes cost you half.

callings.name: Quartermaster
callings.perk: Takes a cut: +150 whenever anyone else gets paid.

callings.name: Privateer
callings.perk: Letter of marque: raids you win steal double.

callings.name: Carpenter
callings.perk: Ships cost a third less and sell for more.

callings.name: Powder Monkey
callings.perk: Starts with two Fate cards, draws two at a time.

callings.name: Sea Witch
callings.perk: Reads the bones: starts with a free treasure map.

fortune.text: You sold a ‘genuine’ treasure map on Vinted.
Found a fiver in last winter’s coat. Then a doubloon. Then another.
Your nan left you her emergency rum money.
Won the pub quiz at the Spoons in Tortuga.
A merchant ship surrendered before you’d even shouted.
Your parrot went viral on TikTok.
Returned a lost chest. The reward was bigger than the chest.
Scratchcard from the corner shop actually paid out.
Sold your cutlass collection on Facebook Marketplace.
Got a tax rebate from the Admiralty. Nobody knows why.
Your shanty got played on Radio 1.
Rented the cabin out on Airbnb while you were at sea.
Ryanair refunded you. Genuinely. First time ever.
Dug up a chest on Brighton beach. Metal detector paid off.
Got paid to appear in the background of EastEnders.
Matched a rich widow’s parrot on a dating app. Long story.
Flogged a ‘cursed’ doubloon to a tourist in Cornwall.
The bookies let you bet on the Grand National. Your horse won.
Sold your Greggs loyalty points to a desperate Navy officer.
Cashed in a jar of pennies at the bank. It was all gold.
A pigeon dropped a diamond on your hat.
Won Bake Off with a ship’s biscuit. The judges wept.
Got your deposit back from the landlord. Every penny.
Found a forgotten ISA you opened in 2014.
Pawned your wooden leg. Bought a nicer wooden leg. Still up.
Your uncle’s crypto actually went up.
Ran a sold-out walking tour of famous shipwrecks.
Found a full Nando’s card in a sunken galleon.
A Love Island contestant paid you to teach them to sword fight.
Sold the rights to your memoir. It’s mostly lies.
The Navy paid you to stop singing outside their fort.
Won a game of cards against a duke. He was very drunk.
Caught a fish. Inside the fish: a gold ring.
Your car-boot sale stall of ‘antique’ cannonballs sold out.
Opened a pop-up rum bar in Shoreditch. Hipsters loved it.
Got a cash-back cheque from an energy company. Suspicious, but fine.
Took the Tube without tapping in. Saved a fortune over the years.
Sold your ship’s figurehead to a Wetherspoons for decor.
Accidentally became a children’s party pirate. Booked solid.
Won a raffle at the village fete. First prize: a small barrel of gold.
A seagull nicked your chips and dropped a purse instead.
Your treasure map turned up on Antiques Roadshow. Valuable!
Sponsored by a hot sauce brand. You just have to shout its name.
Boarded a Deliveroo boat. It was carrying gold, not curry.
Your Premium Bonds finally came good.
Sold your old Pokémon cards. One was shiny.
A grateful mermaid paid you back for that sandwich.
Found buried treasure while digging a hole for a barbecue.

misfortune.text: Got clamped outside the harbour. On a boat.
Council tax arrived. Even pirates pay council tax, apparently.
Lost your wallet in Tortuga. Again.
The parrot ordered a Deliveroo on your card. Forty times.
Ryanair charged you for your wooden leg as extra luggage.
Barnacles on the hull. The cleaning bill is eye-watering.
Bought the round. The whole tavern was in.
Your gym membership renewed. You haven’t been since March.
Dropped your phone over the side. Then your spare phone.
A seagull stole your Greggs and your gold tooth.
Lost a bet on the darts at the Spoons.
Got scammed by a ‘Nigerian prince’ with a very nice ship.
The rats unionised. Their demands were reasonable.
Speeding fine. In a rowing boat. Somehow.
Your crypto went down. Of course it did.
Hired a shanty band for a party. They charged by the verse.
The landlord kept your deposit for ‘cutlass marks on the walls’.
Ordered a treasure chest off Temu. It was the size of a matchbox.
Spent the night in the Navy’s cells. Bail wasn’t cheap.
Contactless at a festival. You don’t remember most of it.
Your hat blew off at Blackpool. You bought six more.
The cabin flooded. Your PS5 is now a fish tank.
A mermaid sued you for emotional damages.
Paid for Netflix, Disney+, Prime and Sky. Watched none of them.
Train strike. You had to get an Uber from Bristol to Plymouth.
Bought a ‘lucky’ coin. It was cursed. Obviously.
Stag do in Magaluf. Nobody talks about it.
Accidentally bought a timeshare on a sinking island.
The Navy fined you for not having a TV licence on board.
Treated yourself to a meal deal every day for a year.
Fell asleep on the night bus. Woke up in Wales.
Your ex sold your treasure map on Vinted.
Dentist says your gold teeth need replacing. With more gold.
Lost a duel to a goose. Had to pay its legal fees.
Booked a ‘sea view’ cabin. It was a picture of the sea.
Tipped the shanty singer by mistake with your biggest coin.
The cannon misfired into your own treasure room.
Bought rounds of Jägerbombs for strangers at 2am.

grog.text: You told the barmaid you’re ‘basically a captain’.
You tried to haggle in Aldi.
You called the sea ‘a big puddle’. The sea heard you.
You got seasick in the harbour. It wasn’t even moving.
You sang the first line of a shanty and forgot the rest.
Your parrot repeated something you said about the captain.
You left the group chat on read for three days.
You fell off the gangplank. In front of everyone.
You put pineapple on the ship’s pizza. Mutiny was discussed.
You said ‘one more’ at the Spoons. It was not one more.
You waved at a Navy ship thinking it was your mate’s.
You texted your ex ‘ahoy’ at 3am.
You buried your treasure and forgot where. Ask the crew for help.
The bosun’s in a good mood: hand out swigs to whoever you like.
You won the arm-wrestle. The losers are your choice.
You found the rum store. Share the love (or the punishment).
Captain for a day: dish out the grog.
You caught someone napping on watch. Pick who pays.
You’ve got dirt on everyone. Spend it wisely.
Your round. Point at the lucky winners.
Revenge is sweet, and it comes in a tankard.
A toast to the Kraken! Everyone raise a glass.
Land ho! The whole crew celebrates.
Somebody’s birthday. Probably. Everyone drinks to be safe.
To absent friends, lost at sea and lost at Magaluf.
Cheers to the cook. Nobody’s died this week.
You tell a joke so bad the whole crew drinks to forget it.
You found a shortcut. Everyone else rowed the long way.
You’re buying, they’re drinking. Smug face on.
You out-sang the whole tavern. The rest drink in shame.
Tall poppy tax: the richest pirate drinks.
The taxman’s in town. Whoever’s got the most gold buys the rum.
Nobody likes a show-off. Richest pirate, bottoms up.
Skint again? The poorest pirate drowns their sorrows.
Pity grog for the pirate with the emptiest pockets.
The crew’s whip-round is for the poorest pirate’s tankard.
You and your shipmate got caught snogging in the crow’s nest.
Date night in Tortuga. You and your shipmate share a tankard.
Your shipmate dared you. Now you both regret it.
Rule of the Sea: make a rule out loud. Anyone who breaks it drinks.
Categories: pick a topic, go round the room. First to stall drinks.
Never Have I Ever, sailor’s edition: say one. Anyone who has, drinks.
Rhyme Time: say a word. Round the room, rhyme it. First to fail drinks.
Thumb Master: put your thumb on the table any time. Last to copy drinks.
Parrot Master: until your next go, anyone who talks to you drinks.
Waterfall: you start drinking, everyone joins. Nobody stops before you.
Pirate Voice: everyone talks like a pirate till your next go. Slip up, drink.
Most Likely To: ask who’s most likely to… On three, point. Most points drinks.

crew.text: A stowaway climbs out of a rum barrel and says ‘alright?’
You press-ganged a lad asleep outside a Wetherspoons.
Twins wash ashore, both called Gaz.
A parrot adopts you. It counts as crew. It insists.
A deckhand joins after seeing your ad on Gumtree.
A retired Navy cook defects for better rum.
Two backpackers on a gap year sign on for the vibes.
You won a sailor in a game of cards.
A mermaid’s cousin wants to see the world.
An influencer joins for the content.
Your mate from uni turns up and never leaves.
A shanty choir from Cornwall needs a lift.
A monkey in a waistcoat signs the articles with a cross.
A deliveryman rows out with a parcel and decides to stay.
You rescued two sailors from a pedalo at Skegness.
A ghost moves into the galley. Surprisingly helpful.
A cabin boy fresh out of Pirate Academy reports for duty.
A hen party mistook your ship for a booze cruise. Two stayed.
A lost tourist with a selfie stick joins up.
A carpenter swaps a lifetime of hammering for a hammock.

kraken.text: A tentacle came over the rail and took someone with it.
A storm swept a deckhand overboard. They waved.
A crew member ran off with a mermaid.
Mutiny! One of the crew rowed off with the biscuits.
A sea serpent ate the night watch. And his sandwich.
A deckhand quit to become a TikTok fisherman.
The Navy press-ganged one of yours in port.
A rogue wave in the Bay of Biscay. Headcount: one short.
Someone went to the Spoons for one and never came back.
The Kraken stirs. A crewmate is dragged into the deep.
Sirens sang. One of yours swam off to find them.
Scurvy took one. Should’ve packed the oranges.
A giant crab pinched a deckhand and scuttled off.
A crew member got a better offer on LinkedIn.
